name: evidence-first-scholar-assessment
description: DORA-informed, evidence-first assessment of research quality and scholarly influence.

interface.longDescription: Assess an academic's research quality and scholarly influence through identity-validated evidence, output-level reading, responsible metrics, contribution attribution, matched-peer context, uncertainty analysis, and auditable reporting.
defaultPrompt: Assess this scholar's research quality and impact using an evidence-first, DORA-informed approach.
Audit this academic profile for identity errors, metric limitations, and unsupported impact claims.
Create an auditable senior-appointment research assessment with matched-peer context.

publication.release_notes: Adds Apache License 2.0 coverage and attribution notices to the repository and standalone plugin package.
